2026-09-29: attempted first-speech Hansard retrieval (18 August 2011) without usable full transcript. No career facts inferred from inaccessible text. Legitimately public LinkedIn result showed current activity, not employment chronology.

Unverified lead only: SignalHire supplied month-level dates for Mallesons (September 2010–July 2011), party (October 2008–August 2010), Unions NSW (June 2004–October 2008), AWU (May 1995–July 2004). Do not promote these data-broker dates without reliable confirmation; no contact data collected.
Study/qualifications: economics degree and law diploma (graduated 2001) do not establish paid work. Potential study/work overlap remains unresolved; no study time counted.

All headline values remain null: incomplete history and hours evidence are missing evidence, not zero. Later follow-up must cover excluded roles as chronology as well as potentially countable employment.
